title: 第19章 遭遇诡打墙第20章 进入黑水县
slug: 开局黑狼拳简化后让我学狼叫
content_zh:
“时间紧迫，先不管山不山阴功。”
赵寒立刻收拾起东西，将战利品一股脑的塞入系统空间内。
随后将王豹的尸体立了起来靠在桌案边。
因为帐篷内有灯火，从外面是看得到有个人坐着的，这样也不会引人怀疑。
用刀划开帐篷后面的口子，赵寒去了趟厨房，将食物往空间里塞。
肉干和面饼，大量的食物塞满了空间。
还有火把、布匹、火油、火折子，这大晚上的赶路，没有火可不行。
赵寒穿越后的身体，也就一个农夫，营养补充不够，缺少维生素，是有夜盲症的。
必须得配齐火把。
衣服上沾了血，赵寒脱下反着穿，就没人看出来了。
离开厨房，手持火把走在黑漆漆的矿场上，迎面遇到一支巡逻队。
领头的赫然是之前透露赵寒信息的王亮。
“赵，赵大哥，晚上好啊。”王亮笑道。
他还以为赵寒不知道他透露信息的事。
其他帮众也都纷纷叫好，满眼羡慕。
毕竟赵寒跨越了阶级，从普通帮众一跃成为精锐帮众，这是他们毕生的梦想。
“都好都好，你们先去巡逻吧，我和小王有事说。”
赵寒对几人挥了挥手，那几人羡慕的看向王亮，知道王亮被赵寒看中了。
王亮还真以为赵寒找他有事呢，等巡逻队刚一走，赵寒直接一伸手就卡住他的脖子。
随后在王亮艰难挣扎和惊恐的眼神中。

一扭，“咔嚓”一声，王亮死。
弄死了王亮，扔垃圾一样扔到黑黢黢的角落，赵寒拍了拍手径直朝门口走去。
“谁！大晚上的出去干嘛？”门口守门的普通帮众立刻拦下了赵寒。
赵大不在里面，他今天白班。
“这是王头目给我的令牌，命我外出。”赵寒将王豹的身份令牌扔了过去，给他们掌掌眼。
看到是新任头目王豹的令牌，几名看守恭敬的将令牌还了回来。
“赵哥慢走！”
离开了矿场，赵寒往黑水县城反方向的南边官道前进，这是做给看守们看的。
走了一截，直到看不到矿场为止，赵寒转道又走了一截林地往北回返，略过了矿场后，沿着官道朝黑水县的方向走去。
“呜呜呜……”
林中，风呼啸的声音划过。
content_en:
"Time is running out, let's not worry about Shan Yin Gong or not."
Zhao Han immediately packed up his things and stuffed the loot into the system space.
Then he stood up Wang Bao's body and leaned it against the table.
Because there are lights inside the tent, you can see someone sitting there from the outside, so it won't arouse suspicion.
Using a knife to cut open the opening at the back of the tent, Zhao Han went to the kitchen and stuffed food into the space.
Dried meat and flatbreads, a lot of food filled the space.
There are also torches, cloth, kerosene, and fire sticks. Traveling at night is impossible without fire.
Zhao Han's body after time travel was just that of a farmer. He had insufficient nutritional supplements, lacked vitamins, and suffered from night blindness.
Must be equipped with torches.
There was blood on his clothes, so Zhao Han took them off and put them on backwards so no one could tell.
Leaving the kitchen, walking in the dark mine field with a torch in hand, he met a patrol.
The leader was clearly Wang Liang, who had revealed Zhao Han's information before.
"Zhao, brother Zhao, good evening." Wang Liang said with a smile.
He thought Zhao Han didn't know about his disclosure of information.
The other members of the gang also applauded and were filled with envy.
After all, Zhao Han transcended class and jumped from an ordinary gang member to an elite gang member. This was their lifelong dream.
"Everything is fine. You go on patrol first. Xiao Wang and I have something to talk about."
Zhao Han waved to a few people, and those people looked at Wang Liang with envy, knowing that Wang Liang was favored by Zhao Han.
Wang Liang really thought that Zhao Han had something to do with him. As soon as the patrol team left, Zhao Han stretched out his hand and clamped his neck.
Then Wang Liang struggled hard and looked frightened in his eyes.
With a twist, there was a "click" and Wang Liang died.
After killing Wang Liang and throwing it into a dark corner like trash, Zhao Han clapped his hands and walked straight towards the door.
"Who! Why are you going out at night?" The ordinary gang member guarding the door immediately stopped Zhao Han.
Zhao Da is not inside, he is on day shift today.
"This is the token given to me by Boss Wang, ordering me to go out." Zhao Han threw Wang Bao's identity token over and gave them the palm of his hand.
Seeing that it was the token of the new leader Wang Bao, several guards respectfully returned the token.
"Brother Zhao, walk slowly!"
After leaving the mine, Zhao Han headed towards the southern official road in the opposite direction of Heishui County. This was for the guards to see.
After walking for a while until the mine was no longer in sight, Zhao Han turned around and walked through the woodland for a while before heading back north. After passing the mine, he walked along the official road towards Heishui County.
"Woooooooo..."
In the forest, the sound of howling wind passed through.
